gateRule: PASS on a disclosed fallback. FAIL on an undisclosed fallback. Content presence is never gated on.

notes: EXTERNAL CONSUMERS: markerAttribute, markerValues, censusArtifact and censusSchema are the stable public surface. Assert on these rather than building a parallel check; they are pinned here so no consumer has to parse prose or read this repo's checker.
The marker is emitted structurally by markerEmitter on BOTH branches from one discriminant — a page author cannot forget it, so an undisclosed fallback is unreachable.
